Record Class InstructorRecruitmentsController.CandidateRankingPage

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.controller.InstructorRecruitmentsController.CandidateRankingPage
Enclosing class:
InstructorRecruitmentsController
public static record InstructorRecruitmentsController.CandidateRankingPage(Long recruitmentId, String quarter, RecruitmentType type, LocalDate tentativeOpeningDate, LocalDate primaryConsiderationDate, LocalDate actualOpeningDate, LocalDate actualClosingDate, String reviewStatus, LocalDate facultyReviewOpeningDate, LocalDate facultyRankingDeadline, InstructorRecruitmentsController.CourseDetails course, List<InstructorRecruitmentsController.CourseDetails> otherCourses, Integer allocation, boolean canRank, CourseTargetsService.CourseTargets targets, boolean hasRankedNotInterested) extends Record
Course-scoped metadata shared by rankings and the read-only application page. allocation is how many TAs or ULAs the course was allocated: present for admins, and for instructors only once the admin shows allocations to faculty (issue #178); otherwise null. canRank is whether this user may enter rankings here: the course's instructor of record while reviews are Open, whether or not they are also an admin (issue #202). targets is the course's hiring figures (issue #224), present on the same terms as allocation. hasRankedNotInterested is whether any real, non-cancelled applicant who did not express interest in the course has a ranking for it (issue #221): the page then always shows that tier.
